reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 2 same-intent states (branch_renamed seed 1 resolves to 'merge', which accepts ['merge']), and that is the state the program was compiled from: it declares variant 'rename', but the solution it was compiled from is a 'merge' resolution there, so the declared variant, not the preconditions, is what is wrong

refused_program.intent: When upstream renames its default branch, retarget the current local branch to track the new upstream branch and merge it into the local commits.

postconditions.description: the current branch now tracks upstream's new branch
postconditions.name: tracking_points_to_new_branch
postconditions.probe:
cur=$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD) || exit 1
merge=$(git config --get "branch.$cur.merge") || exit 1
remote=$(git config --get "branch.$cur.remote") || exit 1
[ "$remote" = "{upstream_remote}" ] && [ "$merge" = "refs/heads/{upstream_branch}" ]

postconditions.description: upstream's new branch tip is an ancestor of HEAD
postconditions.name: upstream_is_merged

postconditions.description: the tracked working tree is clean after the merge
postconditions.name: worktree_clean_after_merge

preconditions.description: a remote-tracking ref for upstream's new branch exists
preconditions.name: new_upstream_branch_known

preconditions.description: the current branch tracks a branch other than upstream's new branch
preconditions.name: tracks_superseded_branch
preconditions.probe:
cur=$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD) || exit 1
merge=$(git config --get "branch.$cur.merge") || exit 1
remote=$(git config --get "branch.$cur.remote") || exit 1
[ "$remote" = "{upstream_remote}" ] || exit 1
[ "$merge" != "refs/heads/{upstream_branch}" ]

preconditions.description: upstream's new branch contains commits not in the local branch
preconditions.name: upstream_has_unmerged_commits

preconditions.description: the local branch has commits that are not in upstream's new branch
preconditions.name: local_has_commits_to_preserve

preconditions.description: there are no uncommitted tracked changes that would disturb the merge
preconditions.name: worktree_clean

preconditions.description: no merge is currently in progress
preconditions.name: no_merge_in_progress
